+import heapq
+
+
+def build_order(graph):
+    # Find all nodes (tasks that appear as keys or in prerequisite lists)
+    all_nodes = set()
+    for task in graph:
+        all_nodes.add(task)
+    for prereq in graph.values():
+        all_nodes.update(prereq)
+
+    if not all_nodes:
+        return []
+
+    # Calculate in-degree (number of prerequisites) for each node
+    in_degree = {node: 0 for node in all_nodes}
+
+    # Build adjacency list: who depends on whom
+    dependents = {node: [] for node in all_nodes}
+
+    for task, prereqs in graph.items():
+        for prereq in prereqs:
+            if prereq not in dependents:
+                dependents[prereq] = []
+            dependents[prereq].append(task)
+            in_degree[task] += 1
+
+    # Start with nodes that have no prerequisites, add to min-heap for lex ordering
+    heap = [node for node, degree in in_degree.items() if degree == 0]
+    heapq.heapify(heap)
+
+    result = []
+
+    while heap:
+        # Select lexicographically smallest available node
+        current = heapq.heappop(heap)
+        result.append(current)
+
+        # Update dependent nodes
+        for dependent in dependents[current]:
+            in_degree[dependent] -= 1
+            if in_degree[dependent] == 0:
+                heapq.heappush(heap, dependent)
+
+    # Check for cycles - we should have processed all nodes
+    if len(result) != len(all_nodes):
+        raise ValueError("Cycle detected")
+
+    return result
